title: 19th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/19/1/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: the President's request to approve ambassadors to foreign countries (Constitution Art. 115(d), Foreign Service Act s.14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Continued debate on the Cyber Security Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hussain Nasih, MP for Medhu Henveiru.
Continued debate on the Personal Data Protection Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Ali Ibrahim, MP for Henveiru Hulhangu.
Social Affairs Committee report on its review of the Human Organ Transplantation Bill.
Independent Institutions Committee report on its review of the bill amending the Maldives Pension Act (Law No. 8/2009).
Decentralization Committee report on its review of the bill amending the Decentralization Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: MPs kept debating the new cyber security and data protection bills, and heard committee reports on organ transplants, pension changes and decentralization changes, with ambassador approvals sent to committee.
